verdict.rationale: Warp's marketing says state tax registrations, filings, and payments are handled automatically across all 50 states, and that Warp Agent runs payroll, which covers the multi-state registration part of the story. Per-state withholding calculation is only implied by the filings and payments claim, not documented. All support is first-party marketing copy with no detailed docs or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-state withholding calculation, detail on how multi-state employees (work vs. residence state) are handled, in-depth first-party payroll/tax docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run payroll for employees across multiple states with the right registrations and withholdings per state

citations.quote: Tax registrations, filings, and payments handled automatically across all 50 states.
Warp Agent takes onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits.
